Martin Property Consultants are pleased to present No. 70 The Coombe to the market. This two-bedroom mid-terrace property offers an excellent opportunity for buyers seeking a property they can personalise in one of Dublin's most established and convenient city locations.

The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hallway, a living room, a separate kitchen, and a family bathroom on the ground floor. Upstairs, there are two well-proportioned bedrooms. 

The Coombe is ideally situated in the heart of Dublin 8, within walking distance of the city centre and an excellent range of local amenities. Residents will enjoy easy access to cafés, restaurants, shops, schools, and parks, while nearby transport links provide excellent connectivity across Dublin. Popular destinations including St. Stephen's Green, Phoenix Park, Guinness Storehouse, and St James's Hospital are all within easy reach, making this a highly desirable location for owner-occupiers and investors alike.

No. 70 The Coombe presents a rare opportunity to acquire a property with excellent potential in a mature and well-connected city location. Early viewing is highly recommended.
